llm_response.reason: The website uses the NDAX brand, pretending to be the login portal of a Canadian cryptocurrency exchange, but is hosted on a generic sitebuilder (webflow.io) not used by financial firms. There are suspicious redirects to unknown domains (trenxch.xyz), no business or legal/company information, no legitimate contact or privacy notice. This matches: mimicking legitimate companies, spoofing login portals, absence of authenticity ID, possibly credential harvesting, and no verification of actual connection to NDAX. These are primary indicators of a cryptocurrency scam/phishing website.
